name: genpark-enterprise-spreadsheet-formula-dag-synthesizer-skill
description: Enterprise Spreadsheet Financial Model & Formula DAG Synthesizer (inspired by Tencent WorkBuddy Goal-to-Excel Workflows). Synthesizes multi-tab financial models, detects circular references, compiles formula dependency DAGs (SUMIFS, XLOOKUP, CAGR, NPV), and evaluates deterministic preview cell matrices.

tools.name: synthesize_spreadsheet_formula_dag
tools.description: Enterprise goal-to-spreadsheet synthesis: define multi-tab models, compile formula dependency DAGs, detect circular reference deadlocks, and evaluate deterministic cell value matrices.

cell_definitions.description: Dictionary of cell coordinates to formula or scalar values (e.g. {'A1': 100, 'A2': '=A1*1.2'}).
